title: Kenyan Vegetable Bake
description: A flavorful and healthy vegetable bake inspired by Kenyan cuisine, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Peel and chop the sweet potatoes, carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers into 1-inch pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Transfer the vegetable mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with chopped sweet potatoes, carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers.
Sprinkle the bake seasoning over the top of the vegetables.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
